context.description: Liveness comes from the status tags and the heartbeat

evidence.trustReason: Fresh review at 162ce61dee. Given a status file / When no ended tag and heartbeat <=15 s: test 1 drives the real taskView machine (viewFor) at 0 and 15000 ms live, 15001 and 60000 ms still, LIVE_MS=15000, and the machine's own feed over a real status.json with the real clock reads the liveness region live. Then Tab, esc twice, watch keys act when owned: test 2 loads the real plugin entry with opencode keymap and SDK; Tab selects T1.3 (agent key untouched), ctrl+x w navigates to watch ses_harness_0, esc twice aborts ses_root and toasts the restart line. And older/absent heartbeat still, ended ended, no file absent: test 1 covers viewFor and disk feed cases, including live->still on aging, live, ended, absent transitions. And run keys leave the run alone when not live or not owned: test 3 (live unowned, minute-old, no heartbeat, ended, no file) asserts Tab reaches the agent key, bar unchanged, no navigation, toast or abort; test 4 proves the machine stop key does not arm while still/ended and an armed key stops nothing after liveness leaves live. Commit 162ce61dee only adds bounded waits (100 settles) before three positive checks; each is followed by the unchanged exact assertion, so a missing or extra event still fails; the SimulatedClock does not move during the wait, so the 5 s stop window cannot disarm the key and the disarm stays attributable to liveness. Negative checks keep one settle, unchanged. Focused rerun: 4 pass, 0 fail, 71 expects, 15.9 s.
